name: plumb
description: Plumb the problem before you build, then plumb the result against reality. Routes every change to a lane (bug, refactor, feature, epic, prototype, investigate) and sets rigor by size and reversibility. Combines Matt Pocock's alignment flow (grilling, glossary, spec, tracer-bullet tickets, two-axis review) with pstack's routing, real-surface proof, and lessons encoded as checks.
